953328.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Bingham Farms
953328.note: Detroit Jewish News (4 July 2024) list of Michigan Chabad institutions founded since 1994: 'Chabad-Lubavitch of Bingham Farms - 2009'. Only this list gives 2009; the first Jewish News mention found is Dec 2016. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 29300 Lancaster Drive, Suite 204, Southfield (July 2011); it is now at 7475 Wing Lake Road, Bloomfield Hills, listed there by Jan 2015, so it moved there between July 2011 and Jan 2015.

earlier.where: 29300 Lancaster Drive, Suite 204, Southfield (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived July 26 2011)

3393324.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Bloomfield Hills
3393324.note: Chabad.org, 19 Oct 2016: 'co-directors of the recently founded Chabad of Bloomfield Hills', the Dubovs having just moved to the Detroit area; the Jewish News (2020) also says 2016. The July 2024 list's 2017 is a year off. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 880 North Pemberton Road, Bloomfield Hills (Apr 2017); it is now at 3805 Quarton Road, Bloomfield Hills, listed there by Feb 2018, so it moved there between Apr 2017 and Feb 2018.

earlier.where: 880 North Pemberton Road, Bloomfield Hills (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Apr 29 2017)

3829994.name: MSU Chabad
3829994.note: Detroit Jewish News (4 July 2024) list: 'Chabad Student Center at MSU - 2018'; founded by Rabbi Bentzion and Simi Shemtov (Jewish News, 2019). Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 432 Kensington Road, East Lansing (Feb 2019); it is now at 115 Albert Avenue, East Lansing, so it moved there after Feb 2019 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 432 Kensington Road, East Lansing (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Feb 28 2019)
